title: Lightweight Anonymized Project Traffic & Attention Tracker
summary: Implemented a privacy-first, zero-cookie telemetry tracker for development staff and the site owner to observe real-time project popularity, dwell time, and device distribution across all site tools.

changes.description: Anonymized Traffic & Attention Tracker: Records project views, active dwell time, session counts, and mobile vs. desktop distribution with zero personal data collection.
Integrated Analytics Card: Real-time visual popularity breakdown ranking projects by engagement in the Feedback & Evolution Hub and Projects Directory.

title: Community Feedback & Autonomous Evolution Inventory
summary: Introduced universal site feedback and recommendation inventory. Allows any user to propose enhancements or report issues for any aspect of the site (Kids Activity Hub, BART Planner, RoboInvestor, Games, Navigation). Evaluates technical feasibility and provides an owner review deck for development staff and the site owner to acknowledge, approve, and mark deployed, laying the foundation for recursive agentic automation.

changes.description: Universal Feedback & Recommendation Engine: Users can submit feedback across all projects with auto-categorization, target tracking, and community upvoting.
Public Inventory & Evolution Roadmap: Real-time inventory displaying status breakdown (Submitted, Acknowledged, In Pipeline, Feasibility Approved, Deployed) with search and category filtering.
Agent Feasibility Synthesis & Owner Review Deck: Heuristic technical impact analysis, complexity estimates, test plans, and one-click owner approval workflows for site owner and development staff.
Global quick-trigger floating button and direct in-page feedback triggers in the Kids Activity Hub and navigation menus.

title: Kids & Youth Activity Hub — Universal Unbiased Aggregator
summary: Removed the studio philosophy matcher feature. Tutu School locations are aggregated seamlessly as standard entries alongside all dance, ballet, swim, gymnastics, martial arts, STEM, and arts activities. All multi-source ratings, transparent prices, and direct registration links are fully unbiased.

changes.description: Removed studio philosophy matcher and benchmark ranking feature to maintain unbiased, comprehensive aggregation across all facilities, organizations, and styles.
Tutu School facilities (Milpitas, Willow Glen, Sunnyvale, Saratoga) integrated as equal first-class activities alongside all other programs within the user-selected zip code and radius.

Universal all-ages activity aggregation across 9 platforms (Sawyer, iClassPro, Mindbody, CivicRec, ActivityHero, Direct Studio portals, Google, Yelp, Winnie) with distance, price, schedule, and live spot filters.

title: Kids & Youth Activity Hub — Universal All-Ages Expansion
summary: Generalized the activity hub into a universal tool for parents with kids of any age (infants to teens, 0 – 17 years). Expanded activities catalog to 44 programs with school-age swim clinics, ninja parkour, youth hip-hop, classical youth ballet, martial arts, robotics STEM, and ceramics.

changes.description: Universal All-Ages Architecture: Broadened hub from toddler-only to any youth age bracket: Babies & Infants (0–18 mo), Toddlers (1.5–3.5 yr), Preschool & Pre-K (3–5.5 yr), Elementary School (5.5–9 yr), Tweens (9–12.5 yr), and Teens (12.5–17 yr).

Expanded 44-Activity Catalog: Added Junior competitive swim team stroke clinics (Calphin & Santa Clara Swim Club), youth gymnastics and ninja agility/parkour (Airborne & Twisters), classical youth ballet & pre-pointe (San Jose Dance Theatre), youth commercial hip-hop crews (Dance Academy USA), junior Taekwondo martial arts, LEGO robotics STEM labs, and potter's wheel ceramic arts.
Neutralized and generalized all UI copy, headers, and reservation forms to be inclusive and versatile for parents with any child of any age.

title: Little Explorer Hub — Editable Origin Zip & Child Age Search Range
summary: Added editable Origin Zip Code field (defaulted to 95131) with real-time driving distance recalculations across all facilities and one-click presets. Added flexible Child Age / Age Range filter allowing parents to search by exact target age (default 3.0 years) or custom min-max age windows.

changes.description: User-editable Origin Zip Code field: Defaulted to 95131 (North San Jose / Berryessa), with one-click quick presets (Milpitas 95035, Santa Clara 95054, Willow Glen 95125, Campbell 95008, Sunnyvale 94086, Mountain View 94041, Fremont 94538) and an instant 'Reset to default 95131' button.
Dynamic driving distance recalculation: Distances from the active zip code to all facilities and distance badges on activity cards update dynamically with real-time road factor adjustments.
Child Age & Age Range search: Filter by exact child age (defaulted to 3.0 years for 3-year-olds) or custom Min-Max age brackets (1.0 to 5.0 years) with automatic overlap matching.
Expanded toddler activities catalog to 31 verified programs spanning infant/toddler to pre-k classes.

title: Little Explorer Hub — 95131 Radius & 9 Multi-Source Expansion
summary: Expanded Little Explorer Hub to 26+ facilities within a 30-mile radius of Zip Code 95131 (North San Jose / Berryessa) across Swimming, Gymnastics, Ballet, Dance, and Sensory disciplines. Integrated 9 verified data sourcing engines including ActivityHero, Sawyer, iClassPro, Mindbody, City Parks & Rec (CivicRec), Winnie, Google, and Yelp.

changes.description: Geographically calibrated all facilities and driving distances to Zip Code 95131 (North San Jose), adding quick radius presets for 5mi, 10mi, 15mi, 20mi, and 30mi covering Milpitas, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Campbell, Fremont, and the Peninsula.
Expanded dataset from 7 to 26+ top-tier facilities with authentic addresses, verified phone numbers, direct registration URLs, and schedules tailored for 3-year-olds.

Added comprehensive Data Sources & Aggregation Directory documenting all 9 integrated platforms (ActivityHero, Sawyer, iClassPro, Mindbody, CivicRec, Winnie, Google Places, Yelp Bay Area Parents, Direct Studio) with live counts and platform filtering.
Added verified Municipal Parks & Recreation integration for City of San José PRNS (Berryessa Community Center) and City of Milpitas Recreation for affordable local programs.

title: Little Explorer Hub — Toddler Activity Aggregator (Project #3)
summary: Launched the third core project under My Projects: a comprehensive local activity aggregator tailored for 3-year-olds. Aggregates verified swimming, gymnastics, creative dance, and classical pre-ballet classes with cross-platform ratings (Winnie, Google, Yelp), transparent pricing, live seat availability, and direct booking links.

changes.description: Launched Little Explorer Hub as Project #3 in My Projects with dedicated route /myprojects/toddler-activities.
Built curated activity pooling for 3-year-olds covering Swimming (90°F heated pools), Gymnastics (foam pits & low beams), Creative Dance, and Storybook Pre-Ballet.
Integrated cross-platform review aggregation combining Google Maps, Yelp, Winnie, and ActivityHero with verified parent testimonials and composite scoring.
Added real-time pricing breakdowns ($/class, monthly tuition, free trial offers) and live slot availability trackers (spots open, waitlist, instructor credentials).
Provided direct reservation links and interactive 1-click spot reservation flow with calendar (.ics) invite export and studio portal redirection.

title: BART Live Map Telemetry & Consist Car Tracker Overhaul
summary: Enhanced the real-time BART Live Map with physical train car counts next to train icons, next-upcoming-station arrival and departure telemetry, labeled all 49 stations across the network, and multi-line color picker support.

changes.description: Replaced the generic indicator next to the train icon with the actual number of train cars on that consist (e.g. [8 Cars 🚆] and [10 Cars 🚆]), clearly displaying consist capacity on both the live map station labels and locomotive markers.

Calibrated Live Map Expected Arrival and Departure to explicitly represent the next upcoming station (when the train will arrive at and depart from the next stop), alongside a full stop-by-stop timetable for all upcoming stations on the train's route.
Rendered all 49 BART station names directly on the Live Map SVG with calibrated non-overlapping coordinates, transfer hub typography, and pulsing train presence halos.
Enabled multi-select line color filtering allowing users to pick any combination of transit lines simultaneously (Green, Yellow, Red, Orange, Blue) with active train counters per line.
Implemented adaptive multi-device layout with expanded desktop main workspace (max-w-7xl) and touch-optimized navigation drawer for mobile and Android Chrome.

title: BART Schedule Planner — Bay Area Rapid Transit Engine
summary: Launched the second core project under My Projects: a real-time route, departure, and live train tracker for the San Francisco Bay Area BART rail network, featuring origin-station departures and line-specific train position filtering.

changes.description: Added BART Schedule Planner as second sub-project in My Projects with dedicated route: /myprojects/bart.

Resolved Southbound Green Line train tracking: normalized BART API legacy Route 6 direction discrepancy (Berryessa correctly designated Southbound and Daly City Northbound) and expanded consist tracking to continuously capture all active en-route trains in both directions.
Added Northbound and Southbound direction filters to live system map and dispatch ledger, with consist counts and interactive toggles.
Broke out train direction into its own dedicated column in the Live Train Dispatch Ledger with high-contrast Northbound and Southbound indicators.
Added dynamic real-time departure boards updating from the perspective of the origin station whenever a new station is selected.
Added line-specific filtering toggles (Green, Yellow, Red, Orange, Blue) to isolate active train positions and dispatch ledger entries.
Implemented live BART Train Dispatch Ledger with instant view mode toggles and jump navigation.
Calibrated Milpitas-Embarcadero transit time to ~59 min (about 1 hr) and Clipper fare to $9.65 ($4.80 Youth, $3.60 Senior).

title: Robinhood Agentic Investment Sentinel — Transparency Dashboard
summary: Launched the first core project: an autonomous investment agent integrating with Robinhood's agentic solution, designed with radical public transparency across constraints, evolution logs, and execution rationale.

changes.description: Featured the Transparent Investment Agent in 'My Projects' with active monitoring telemetry.
Defined full active constraint rulebook (15% position caps, 10% dry powder reserve, -6.5% trailing stop, asset universe, sector limits).
Implemented public Decision Ledger detailing exact buy/sell actions with deep analytical 'Why' rationale and constraint verification checks.
Built Constraint Evolution History timeline documenting what rules changed over time and the strategic reasoning behind each refinement.

title: Cosmic Dodger Combat Mechanics & Plasma Cannons
summary: Transformed Cosmic Dodger from an evasion-only runner into an active arcade combat game with responsive shooting controls, sound effects, and particle physics.

changes.description: Added wing-mounted plasma laser cannons with fire rate limiter (SPACEBAR, W, ↑, or on-screen FIRE button).
Implemented laser-asteroid collision detection with real-time radial explosion particles and scoring (+25 pts per hit).
Synthesized retro laser firing and asteroid impact audio sweeps using the Web Audio API.
Added real-time 'Destroyed' asteroid count tracker to the in-game telemetry dashboard.
Added platform attribution notice: 'Built with Google AI Studio & Google Antigravity'.

title: Minimalist Layout Integration & Default Blank Canvas
summary: Redesigned the layout so the left navigation is naturally integrated into the page without a detached sidebar, eliminated duplicate buttons, and established the default blank state on Huon.si.

changes.description: Configured Huon.si on the top left to navigate to a peaceful blank state, and set it as the default arrival screen.
Integrated left navigation directly into the main page grid, removing full-height sidebar borders.
Eliminated duplicate CTA buttons on the homepage for a pure, distraction-free interface.
Removed all mock design work cards and personal identity data, keeping the About Me page blank for now.

title: Custom Domain Integration & Automated CI/CD
summary: Configured custom domain routing for huon.si with Namecheap DNS and automated the deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions.

changes.description: Bound huon.si apex domain and CNAME records to GitHub Pages via Namecheap Advanced DNS.
Created .github/workflows/deploy.yml for zero-touch Vite builds and automated GitHub Pages artifact deployment.
Resolved npm peer dependency resolution conflicts (vite vs esbuild) with .npmrc legacy-peer-deps configuration.
Added root and public CNAME files for automated SSL/TLS provisioning on huon.si.

title: 60fps Animated Canvas Rocketship & Cosmic Dodger
summary: Built a custom HTML5 canvas deep space environment with physics-driven rocketship animations, followed by the first playable prototype of Cosmic Dodger.

changes.description: Created AnimatedRocketScene canvas with multi-layer starfields, twinkling stars, celestial nebulae, and shooting stars.
Engineered sinusoidal floating physics, glowing ion thrusters, and active particle exhaust emitting from rocket nozzles.
Prototyped the initial Cosmic Dodger canvas arcade game with player movement, asteroid spawning, and collision detection.

title: Genesis: Project Specification & Hub Setup
summary: Initialized the experimental portfolio codebase with Astro, Tailwind CSS v4, and subdomain routing architecture.

changes.description: Initialized local Git repository with branch main and established project structure.
Configured Astro spec, Layout.astro, and Vercel edge deployment settings.
Authored README.md documenting architecture and local development workflows.
